answer: An attacker must buy real stake for every fake reputation slot and sustain it across epochs, since a single flagged dune of colluding accounts slashes the whole group. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted peer attestation: each agent must lock a bond before attesting, and peers sample attestations against a shared reputation kernel that flags clusters of freshly funded identities. Honest participants on the knoll of long tenure earn discounted bond rates, making mass identity creation costlier than genuine participation. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
